originalGameExtractionProvenance: unconfirmed; PES Master identifies PES 5 pages and says PES 5 assets are Konami property, but the pages do not document whether values were extracted from retail game data, transcribed, or recalculated
displayedOvrSemantics: PES Master displayed OVR; PES5 native-versus-recomputed status unverified; preserve values above 99
searchPageBehavior: The visible PES 5 advanced-search inline script builds /pes-5/search/search.php?name=<term>&sort=ovr&sort_order=desc. The PoC follows that public route for targeted surname queries.
limitations: The script makes one request per selected team page, then one targeted surname query only for unmatched target identities; it never enumerates all PES5 records.
The first page of up to 30 matching search rows is retained; a result page with 30 rows may be truncated.
A result with only a surname and no explicit/manual name match stays identity_unresolved.
No-result means no candidate in that targeted PES Master query, not proof of absence from all PES5 data sources.
The source file fallback-team-seasons.json remains read-only and is not changed.

additionalSourceEvidence.name: PES Master public PES 5 pages
additionalSourceEvidence.finding: Structured PES 5 search/detail pages expose team/player rows, displayed OVR and 28 named ability fields. Retail extraction/transcription/recalculation provenance and PES 5 OVR semantics are undocumented.

additionalSourceEvidence.name: PES Master catalog / editions
additionalSourceEvidence.finding: Current navigation/about evidence covers PES 5 and PES 2008 onward; it did not expose an original PES 3/PES 4/WE4 database in this bounded check.

additionalSourceEvidence.name: Older PES community-stat archive discussion
additionalSourceEvidence.finding: A forum participant identified the posted PES 3 entries as the World patch option file rather than the original PES 3 file. The project separately claimed PES 4 completion, but the discussion does not establish original-ISO extraction or data provenance.

additionalSourceEvidence.name: PES 4 archive extraction discussion
additionalSourceEvidence.finding: Describes PES 4 over.afs archive structure for player names/stats/appearance; extraction is plausible, but this is not an accessible validated original-game player database.

additionalSourceEvidence.name: ISS Pro Evolution player database post
additionalSourceEvidence.finding: A user reports a player database and SQL/Parquet exports; retail extraction provenance was not stated, so it is not treated as confirmed original data.

additionalSourceEvidence.name: PlayersDB identity reference
additionalSourceEvidence.finding: Optional cross-game identity relationships only; not used as a PES ability-value source.

additionalSourceEvidence.name: FIFA 05 overlap pages
additionalSourceEvidence.finding: Three Valencia identity pairs for OVR and displayed fields; page field taxonomy may be modern-standardized and is not proof of native FIFA 05 fields.

additionalSourceEvidence.name: FIFA Soccer 2005 guide
additionalSourceEvidence.finding: Uses legacy field names such as Pace, Shot Accuracy/Power, Passing, Long Balls, Dribbling, Heading, Tackling, Strength, Marking and goalkeeper fields; supports taxonomy caution, not raw-game extraction.

originalGameArchiveConclusion: No accessible, provenance-verified complete original-game PES 3/PES 4/WE4 archive was confirmed in this bounded investigation. Community datasets exist but are patched, self-reported, or provenance-unspecified; this is not a claim that no archive exists anywhere.
